scope: All 28 rendered pages, 6 bucket-specific views, and 22 interaction states. Root and OIDC callback redirect behavior checked separately.
environment: Chromium captures of the actual Next.js application with controlled S3/admin responses. Before uses the baseline development build; after uses the production static export at /rustfs/console. No live RustFS integration is claimed.
theme_capture: The actual theme provider handles light/dark selection; root theme is asserted before state captures.
